blocks.text: Apartment interior design in Warsaw, custom furniture and turnkey renovation, 43 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a project for a 43 m² apartment in Warsaw, Poland: interior design, technical documentation, custom furniture, a turnkey renovation, and decorating.
The interior is contemporary with minimalist touches: understated forms, natural materials, and a calm, neutral palette. In 43 m², every square meter counts.
The furniture and storage systems were custom-made to suit the architecture of the rooms.
The studio then carried out a turnkey renovation based on the technical documentation and installed the custom-made furniture.
The project was completed with made-to-measure curtains and interior decorating.
Below are photos of the finished apartment and the custom-made furniture.
